name: The Workshop
description: The only world starting the child where files and folders sit side by side, so cwd_has_files is true on turn one. One misspellable file, one misspellable folder, an empty room, and a name in the parent.

entries.name: blueprint.txt
entries.content: A machine for folding paper cranes. Step one is missing.

entries.name: hammer.txt
entries.content: Heavy end goes down. Everyone learns this once.

entries.name: wrench.txt
entries.content: Turns bolts. Also good for propping doors open.

entries.name: notes.txt
entries.content: Ideas so far: a quieter clock, a kite that steers.

entries.name: seeds.txt
entries.content: Sunflowers by the fence. Beans where the sun lands first.
